crew.overview: Thor is imprisoned on the other side of the universe and finds himself in a race against time to get back to Asgard to stop Ragnarok, the destruction of his home-world and the end of Asgardian civilization, at the hands of a powerful new threat, the ruthless Hela.
crew.title: Thor: Ragnarok

crew.overview: During World War II, the British Army assigns a group of competent soldiers to carry out a mission against the Nazi forces behind enemy lines... A true story about a secret British WWII organization — the Special Operations Executive. Founded by Winston Churchill, their irregular warfare against the Germans helped to change the course of the war, and gave birth to modern black operations.
crew.title: The Ministry of Ungentlemanly Warfare

details.biography: Ryan Tarran is known for his work on Thor: Ragnarok (2017), Aquaman (2018) and Alien: Covenant (2017).
details.name: Ryan Tarran
